nrIncident.summary: No trains will call at Kentish Town until the end of the day
nrIncident.routes: Between Orpington and West Hampstead Thameslink / Luton, and also between Sutton and St Albans
nrIncident.message:
A power cut at Kentish Town station means no trains can call at this station. As a result, trains running through this station will run non stop.
Disruption is expected until the end of the day.
Customer advice:
If you are travelling to or from Kentish Town, you will need to use London Underground services to complete your journey, as Thameslink trains are currently unable to call at the station.
Due to a local power cut, Thameslink services are running through Kentish Town without stopping in either direction. Please allow up to an extra 15 to 20 minutes to complete your journey via alternative routes.
Alternative travel advice:
Travelling to Kentish Town: If you are travelling southbound, please remain on your train to London St Pancras International; if you are travelling northbound, please alight at London St Pancras International. From there, walk across to Kings Cross St Pancras Underground station to take a Northern line (High Barnet / Mill Hill East branch) train to Kentish Town.
Travelling from Kentish Town: Take a southbound London Underground Northern line service to Kings Cross St Pancras, then walk across to London St Pancras International to join an onward Thameslink train to your destination.
Ticket acceptance:
To complete your journey you can use your ticket on the following at no extra cost
• Any alternative Thameslink service to / from London St Pancras International
• London Underground Northern line services between Kentish Town and London St Pancras International
Planning your journey:
For help planning your journey, check live departure boards, view a live network map or see alternative route guides.
If you’re travelling within London, you can use the TfL Journey Planner.
Can you tell me more about the incident?
A power cut at Kentish Town means that the station lights are not working. As the station is in darkness, it's not safe for trains to call.
Station teams and the local electricity suppliers are working to ensure that the station is returned to a mains electricity supply as quickly as possible.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.

nrIncident.summary: No trains will call at Kentish Town until approximately 07:00
nrIncident.routes: Between Orpington and West Hampstead Thameslink / Luton, and also between Sutton and St Albans
nrIncident.message:
A power cut at Kentish Town station means no trains can call at this station. As a result, trains running through this station will run non stop.
Disruption is expected until approximately 07:00.
Customer advice:
If you are travelling to or from Kentish Town, you will need to use London Underground services to complete your journey, as Thameslink trains are currently unable to call at the station.
Due to a local power cut, Thameslink services are running through Kentish Town without stopping in either direction. Please allow up to an extra 15 to 20 minutes to complete your journey via alternative routes.
Alternative travel advice:
Travelling to Kentish Town: If you are travelling southbound, please remain on your train to London St Pancras International; if you are travelling northbound, please alight at London St Pancras International. From there, walk across to Kings Cross St Pancras Underground station to take a Northern line (High Barnet / Mill Hill East branch) train to Kentish Town.
Travelling from Kentish Town: Take a southbound London Underground Northern line service to Kings Cross St Pancras, then walk across to London St Pancras International to join an onward Thameslink train to your destination.
Ticket acceptance:
To complete your journey you can use your ticket on the following at no extra cost
• Any alternative Thameslink service to / from London St Pancras International
• London Underground Northern line services between Kentish Town and London St Pancras International
Planning your journey:
For help planning your journey, check live departure boards, view a live network map or see alternative route guides.
If you’re travelling within London, you can use the TfL Journey Planner.
Can you tell me more about the incident?
A power cut at Kentish Town means that the station lights are not working. As the station is in darkness, it's not safe for trains to call.
Station teams and the local electricity suppliers are working to ensure that the station is returned to a mains electricity supply as quickly as possible.
Check before you travel:
You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.
Compensation:
You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
